text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Mic test. Mic test. One, two.
It's a
beautiful day today.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Hi, It's Machan. I had the daily special
for lunch
today. And don't worry, I ate
my veggies first.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I had a cup of black tea after I finished,
and
abstained from snacks. Heh-heh.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'm recording a voice message for my
mom.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
She called me the other day worrying
about my diet choices. She said that I
need to stay healthy
to achieve my
dreams.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Sooo... Ta-da! I decided to keep her
updated with
voice memos.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
If I keep it up, I can put my mom at ease
and slim
down while I'm at it. Then, once
I do...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
I'll have her bake a bunch of cookies for
me.
That's my motivation to keep going.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Aston Machan's plan works perfectly
and she
successfully gets back to her
original weight.
